title: Not good for shorter/smaller framed people
text: Not good for shorter/smaller framed people. I’m 5’7” and have a 15.5” neck. This pillow doesn’t prevent my head from tipping forward- feel like it is designed for someone 6’+

product_metadata.title: ALPACA Memory Foam Travel Pillow - Award-Winning Neck Pillow Design Provides Comfortable Head, Neck, and Chin Support for All Sleeping Positions | Premium Breathable Fabric and Machine-Washable Cover
features: ✓ WAKE UP RESTED AND REFRESHED AFTER EVERY FLIGHT -- The award-winning design and comfy memory foam will help you get a good night’s sleep on any flight, whether you’re in an aisle, middle, or window seat.

✓ ROTATES FOR CUSTOMIZABLE HEAD AND NECK SUPPORT IN ANY POSITION -- Whatever sleeping position is most natural for you, the Alpaca pillow will gently support your head and neck without pushing your head forward. Rotate the pillow to the position you find most comfortable for side sleeping or upright sleeping - with ample chin support to prevent head-bobbing. Use the front drawstring to adjust for an even better fit.

✓ DESIGNED FOR AIR TRAVEL. WORKS WITH HEADPHONES -- Airplanes are cramped, noisy places. Rest assured that the loose feel of the Alpaca pillow transforms into an ideal fit when you are settled into an airline seat. And unlike other pillows, the Alpaca is designed to work with your favorite noise-cancelling headphones. The result? Comfort when it matters most.

✓ EASILY COMPRESS AND PACK IT AWAY IN YOUR CARRY-ON -- The Alpaca pillow is extremely portable and can be packed away into its own attractively-designed travel bag. It weighs less than a pound and compresses to a very compact 7”x6”x6”, so you can easily stow it in your purse, backpack, or any other carry-on item.

✓ STAY COOL WITH HIGH-QUALITY, BREATHABLE FABRIC -- The Alpaca pillow feels great against your skin and will keep your face and neck cool on long flights. The outside cover is made of a velvety soft yet durable fabric that’s also machine washable.
